title: Code-Action Minimalist Agent Framework by Hugging Face
oneLiner: Hugging Face's `smolagents` enables LLMs to express tool calls directly as executable Python code snippets (`CodeAgent`) inside sandboxed environments, reducing multi-step JSON tool-calling overhead.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Hugging Face's `smolagents` enables LLMs to express tool calls directly as executable Python code snippets (`CodeAgent`) inside sandboxed environments, reducing multi-step JSON tool-calling overhead.
requirements: Hugging Face token or OpenAI/LiteLLM API key
steps: Run `agent.run()` on data or web tasks.
configSnippet: "Write Python code using the provided search and calculator tools to compare 5-year GDP growth rates across G7 nations."
limitations: Executing model-generated Python requires strict E2B or Docker sandboxing in production.
